prompt:
Professional fashion photograph, close-up beauty portrait. TWO women standing close together, shoulders touching, each facing the camera straight on in a perfectly frontal portrait, heads level, both ears of every woman clearly visible on either side of her face, framed tightly from the very top of their heads down to the line of their shoulders, the frame cutting off just below them, so the weights fully hang in view. Every face is large and sharp. All of them stand together in one single shared scene, in one row in front of the same continuous background, and this is one single photograph taken with one camera at one moment, not a collage: the women overlap slightly in depth and the background runs unbroken behind all of them.

#1: A striking adult Japanese woman — Japanese poised refined beauty light-neutral complexion with a soft peach-beige undertone and real visible pores, mid 30s, sleek black shoulder-length hair with a side part, vivid bright turquoise coloured contact lenses with a heart-shaped pupil, both eyes the same, fully opaque and solidly saturated across the whole iris with no natural brown showing through, the colour bright and unmistakable, with a darker limbal ring, sitting naturally on the irises and clear of the eyelids, a slow, lingering gaze, lips closed in a restrained knowing half-smile, an alluring, mature, magnetic expression — a photograph of a real Japanese woman's face, not an illustration, not a render. Her whole face, ears and neck are real living skin with visible pores and faint peach-fuzz hairs, slightly asymmetrical with a few small natural beauty marks and freckles, never airbrushed and never smooth like plastic, real wet catchlights in the eyes, individual hair strands catching the light. Her face has been surgically sculpted far beyond her natural look, and these changes override her natural features: her eyes are the star of her face (the shape, size and lenses described here override the eyes of her makeup, while the colours of her eyeshadow and liner follow her makeup): enormous, perfectly round, wide, innocent doe eyes of impossible size, each eye about twice as large as a normal eye with an enormous visible iris that fills almost the whole opening, with a soft white inner liner along the lower lash line, extremely long, thick, curled lashes like little fans and a small softly shaded flick under the lower lashes, in coloured contact lenses, both eyes the same, with a round natural pupil and bright catchlights, still sweet and beautiful. Every feature is exaggerated but beautiful, balanced and refined, in harmony with the rest of her face, never distorted, never grotesque.

#1 Piercings: A face fully covered with real piercings, about thirteen in total (not counting the hanging weights), spread over every area so that no area is empty: a single large septum ring of different sizes and shapes through the thin soft wall between the nostrils, in a short stack that ends above the upper lip; one small ring wrapping snugly around each nostril wing; one small hoop or stud along the edge of the upper lip; one small hoop or stud across the lower lip's edge; one small ring or stud on the chin; on each ear, two separate large healed openings in the earlobe, one below the other with a clear gap of bare skin between them, each opening holding its own very thick, heavy black cast-iron ring as thick as a finger, a plain solid ring with no open tunnel, and above them sit three thick classic round O-rings and studs along the helix rim above the lobe; one small stud across the lower half of the forehead just above the brows in even rows, leaving the upper forehead free; one small stud along each cheekbone, well clear of the eyes. Stickers: five tiny glow-in-the-dark heart and star stickers are scattered flat on the skin of the lower cheeks and the jawline below the cheekbone studs, clear of the piercings, the eyes and the lips. The face and ear jewelry is real mixed yellow gold, silver and rose gold set with glossy multicoloured enamel and rainbow gemstones. Her ear weights are each a different shape and a different metal among gold, bronze, iron, tin, brass, silver, copper and lead.

#2: A striking adult Korean woman — Korean poised refined beauty fair complexion with a neutral-rose undertone and real visible pores, mid 30s, a polished low bun with a few loose strands, extremely heavy, fully saturated and bold, never subtle, faded or blended away: thin sharply arched brows, soft brown and rose eyeshadow, a fine black liner with a small flick, long curled lashes, large eyes with bright real catchlights, a strong rose-red blush on the apples of the cheeks, deep glossy red lips with a defined edge, vivid bright turquoise coloured contact lenses with a radiating sunburst iris pattern, both eyes the same, fully opaque and solidly saturated across the whole iris with no natural brown showing through, the colour bright and unmistakable, with a darker limbal ring, sitting naturally on the irises and clear of the eyelids, gazing down from beneath lowered lids with the chin raised high as if looking down on a subject kneeling before her, lips sealed in a faint regal curve, an imperious, queenly, commanding expression — a photograph of a real Korean woman's face, not an illustration, not a render. Her whole face, ears and neck are real living skin with visible pores and faint peach-fuzz hairs, slightly asymmetrical with a few small natural beauty marks and freckles, never airbrushed and never smooth like plastic, real wet catchlights in the eyes, individual hair strands catching the light. Her face has been surgically sculpted far beyond her natural look, and these changes override her natural features: her eyes are the star of her face (the shape, size and lenses described here override the eyes of her makeup, while the colours of her eyeshadow and liner follow her makeup): the ultimate extreme eyes, beyond any real surgery but still beautiful: the outer corners of both eyes are stretched far past her temples to the side of her head near the hairline, and the inner corners are fully opened with the small pink inner corner visible, so each eye opening is about three times its natural length, an extremely long, narrow, razor-sharp almond shape spanning almost the entire width of her face on each side, showing a huge amount of iris and white; a razor-sharp eyeliner in the colour of her makeup follows the entire shape and ends in a very long, sharp point beside the hairline; the eyes are in very large coloured doll-eye contact lenses with a glossy shine and a big iris, both eyes the same, with a round natural pupil and bright catchlights. Every feature is exaggerated but beautiful, balanced and refined, in harmony with the rest of her face, never distorted, never grotesque.

#2 Piercings: A face fully covered with real piercings, about thirteen in total (not counting the hanging weights), spread over every area so that no area is empty: a single large septum ring of different sizes and shapes through the thin soft wall between the nostrils, in a short stack that ends above the upper lip; one small ring wrapping snugly around each nostril wing; one small hoop or stud along the edge of the upper lip; one small hoop or stud across the lower lip's edge; one small ring or stud on the chin; on each ear, two separate large healed openings in the earlobe, one below the other with a clear gap of bare skin between them, each opening holding its own very thick, heavy black cast-iron ring as thick as a finger, a plain solid ring with no open tunnel, and above them sit three thick classic round O-rings and studs along the helix rim above the lobe; one small stud across the lower half of the forehead just above the brows in even rows, leaving the upper forehead free; one small stud along each cheekbone, well clear of the eyes. The face and ear jewelry is real mixed yellow gold, silver and rose gold set with glossy multicoloured enamel and rainbow gemstones. Her ear weights are all rough-cast matte yellow gold, each a different shape.

Ear weights: On each ear of every woman who wears weights, all six weights hang from her iron rings in staggered columns, each weight on its own thick chain of heavy links of the same metal as the weight, the chains of different lengths and staggered at different heights so every weight is fully visible and none hides another. Every single weight is a massive, dense, solid, squat, blunt lump of rough, matte, unpolished heavy metal, in the metal named in her own paragraph, at least as big as her whole fist and clearly larger than her earlobe, with no thin parts, no arms and no hollow parts; the last weight is as big and heavy-looking as the first, each chain pulled bar-straight and taut, the long chains hanging freely in the air, clear of the neck and shoulders, with even the longest chain and its weight ending no lower than the level of the collarbones. Because the load is carried by her iron rings, the weight gently pulls each earlobe down a little into a slightly elongated, soft, healthy loop of skin, only a small natural droop that is just enough to show how heavy the weights are; no lobe stretches long, tears or collapses or hangs down to the neck or shoulder, every head stays upright, and the skin stays smooth and intact, fully healed, with no tearing, no wound, no blood and no redness.

All piercings: Each woman wears only the piercings named in her own paragraph, in those places and nowhere else; on every woman the eyes, eyelids and eyebrows stay completely clear. All jewelry is real metal, sitting in real, calm, healthy skin — no redness, no swelling, no irritation — with a small natural warm shadow under each piece. Every piece stays at least a finger's width from the eyeballs, and no chain or bar crosses the eyes.

Piercing depth: every bar is embedded in the skin so only its two end studs show on the surface; every ring passes through a small healed opening in the skin, the skin visible through the loop, and every stud sits through the skin with its back hidden, all of them passing through the real tissue with the skin wrapping snugly around them.

Hair: every woman's hair is swept back behind both ears, leaving both ears, jawlines and necks fully visible so every hanging piece is in clear view.

Pose: each woman stands upright, arms relaxed at her sides, heads level, shoulder to shoulder and close enough that their shoulders and upper arms touch or slightly overlap in depth, leaning very slightly toward each other, so that the hanging pieces of one never hang in front of another and each woman's hanging pieces stay in front of her own shoulder. They all share one single continuous background behind them, the same one for all of them, with no separate panels, no split screen, no borders and no different backgrounds behind different women. There is no dividing line between the women, and no different light, colour or background on different women.

Lighting: The background is a city street at night in the rain, blurred neon signs and car lights in teal and deep blue, out of focus with a shallow depth of field, with no objects and no other people in the background, and the background is darker and softer than their faces so that their faces and the metal are the brightest, sharpest part of the image. The background colours are cool, mid-to-dark tones clearly different from their skin tones, never beige, peach, orange or brown, and never bright. One single light setup lights everyone from the same direction with the same colour, so the shadows and highlights match on every woman. A soft frontal light on all the faces and ears, so the makeup and the glints on every piece of metal read clearly; a thin cool rim light along the hair and shoulders. 4:3 horizontal 8K.
